messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (prod). Severity: page. p95=1.12s p99=3.20s SLO(p99)=1.0s. Alert: https://grafana.internal/r/dash/latency-alert

maria: ack on pager, joining. anyone oncall?

chris: i'm oncall, grabbing the dashboards now. no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: No recent production deploys in the past 60 minutes.

chris: quick top-level checks:
- grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/rlat/prod-latency (p95 jumped from ~400ms to ~1.1s, p99 to ~3.2s)
- datadog traces show increased tail latencies on inference-worker-*/pod
- spike start ~1965007600 (approx 3m ago)

tariq: checking autoscaler and queue depths now. i'm seeing GPU queue depth spike on pool-inference-east-1 (backlog ~150 requests).

chris: any signs of streaming stalls vs single-shot token slowdowns?

maria: tailing logs from streaming gateway, lots of repeated: `stream stall detected -- missing kv cache hit` and `kv_fetch_timeout=200ms`

maria: logs snippet:
```
[1965007765] worker=inf-03 trace_id=abc123 stream stall detected duration=1200ms kv_fetch=timeout
[1965007766] worker=inf-07 trace_id=def456 upstream_retry=1 dispatch_delay=300ms
[1965007768] worker=inf-03 evicting-kv-keys count=512 reason=memory_pressure
```

lee: looks like a hot KV-cache node is thrashing. also socket backlog rising on the inference service LB. Could be both cache pressure + slower kernel on a subset of GPUs.

chris: triage plan (initial):
1) divert traffic away from affected pods / route to low-latency model variant for 15m canary
2) scale up inference pool by +2 GPUs (fast provision)
3) restart suspected kv-cache pod kv-cache-3
4) monitor p95/p99 and traces for negative regressions

maria: applying routing change now: running:
```
rwdctl route update --service=inference --policy=prefer-low-latency --match=region:east --duration=15m --reason="p99 spike"
```

maria: routing update applied :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Route change submitted (change-id: rc-7821).

chris: scaling GPU pool (executing infra scale).

tariq: restarting kv-cache-3 now (kubectl rollout restart pod/kv-cache-3). I'll watch cache warm-up.

tariq: restart completed, warming. Cache hit rate rising from 62% -> 85% (approx 90s).

chris: quick customer impact check: console shows 0.7% requests above SLO in last 5m, top impacted tenants: tenant-acme, tenant-zeno, tenant-proto (approx 40-120 requests each). notifying account teams.

sarah: notified account teams for tenant-acme and tenant-zeno via email + slack. they acknowledged, asking for ETA.

maria: after routing + cache restart: p95 down to ~520ms, p99 down to ~900ms. trending down.

chris: good signal. keep monitoring for 10m then decide to de-escalate. keep traces open for any residual streaming stalls.

lee: i'm seeing a small subset of workers still with high syscall wait times, likely degraded kernel path on those machines. i'll cordon and rotate them out of the pool after we stabilize.

chris: i'll keep the on-call watch for 30m, then hand off to lee for the next monitoring window. action items:
- chris: keep watch + collate traces for RCA
- t a r i q: follow up on cache eviction thresholds and autoscaler thresholds
- lee: prepare rotation plan for degraded workers
- maria: confirm routing revert when stable

maria: routing will auto-revert after 15m, but i'll manually revert earlier if p99 < 900ms for 5m.

chris: heads-up to SRE lead: pinging @sre-lead for heads-up (FYI only).

sarah: handoff note: i'll keep account comms open.

maria: p95 now 480ms, p99 840ms stable for 2m.

chris: ok i'm going to downgrade pager to watch-only in 10m if numbers stay. will post handoff in 20m.

incident-bot: Event update: p99 returned to 0.85s at 1965007885. Alert auto-resolved.

lee: taking over watch at 1965007890. leaving chris on-call slack for escalation. I'll follow up with RCA tomorrow once traces collected.

chris: thanks all — summary for postmortem: transient KV cache pressure + socket backlog on subset of inference workers caused tail stalls; mitigations: routing to low-latency variant, cache node restart, scale-up, and worker rotation. will collect traces and sample prompts for eval.

maria: closing thread for now, will link to postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
